verdicts.reason: A: the dark header band survives only as a stray black slab at the top centre, cut away from the logo, and the orange divider floats between the columns. The body copy is jammed against the top edge and the headline nearly touches the left edge. Even so, the headline, body, CTA and legal line are all readable, and the CTA is strong. B: the dark block sits as an awkward top-left chunk that crowds the headline. Body copy, CTA and 'Ships late June' are tiny, the legal line is illegible, the divider is stranded at the far right and the right third of the canvas is empty.
